title: Minimal primes lift along injective ring maps
statement: Let $f:R\to S$ be an injective homomorphism of commutative rings. For every minimal prime ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $R$ (a prime ideal with no strictly smaller prime ideal), there is a prime ideal $\mathfrak q$ of $S$ with $f^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$. Equivalently the map on spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum] hits every minimal prime of $R$.
